labels.notes: Unmarked and partial, as dispatched. ledger.py's mark regex (tools/ledger.py:247) finds no match in the first 4000 characters. The label is written `defi:causal_Ealpha` — `ETT.tex:1335` at l.7. The near-miss '**`prop:isom` for' (l.31) does not match, because the closing ** is not adjacent. Both quotes are verbatim: ETT.tex:1336-1340 and BTZ_1.tex:378-383. prop_isom_local, read against BTZ_1's prop:isom: alpha != 2 pi is carried. beta = 2 pi is allowed, and mem_singLine_of_isAEChart excludes it when the source meets the line, since Sing(E_2pi) is empty. alpha, beta > 0 is a special case: E0 -> E0 is BPrimeE0, and E0 <-> E_kappa is the sibling MassAModelsInstance (notMem_axis_of_isAEChart). 'U open connected containing a singular point' becomes p in psi.source with p in singLine alpha, which is weaker because connectedness is dropped. 'phi an a.e. E-morphism and a local homeomorphism' becomes IsAEChart, which is stronger: psi is an OpenPartialHomeomorph, hence injective, and its inverse is an a.e. morphism too. This is gx's IsAEMorphism of the homeomorphism of open subsets (isAEChart_iff_isAEMorphism), i.e. DEC-25's reading, and the same reading BPrimeE0 took. The conclusion alpha' = alpha is proved, not assumed. 'phi is the restriction of an element of Isom(E_alpha)' is narrowed to a ball about p: there psi(t, polar(r, theta)) = (t + s, polar(r, theta + c)) for every polar representation, and every point has one (exists_polar). All of this is disclosed in the docstring checklist (row 2, ⚠) and SCOPE. eq_of_isAEChart: kappa' = kappa from a single line point in the source, with no other hypothesis. Continuity across the slit gives kappa = n kappa', n >= 1; injectivity at +-kappa'/2 gives kappa' >= kappa. exists_eqOn_rotShift is the same-model form on an open O containing p. isAEChart_rotShift (kappa != 2 pi) and chartIso_rotShift (unconditional) give the converse. chartIso_of_isAEChart: every IsAEChart E_kappa -> E_kappa' for kappa, kappa' > 0 is a ChartIso (massive kappa) (massive kappa'), with no other hypothesis. Three cases: kappa = 2 pi (EAlphaGX.chartIso_of_isAEChart_two_pi), a source meeting the line (eq_of_isAEChart, then chartIso_of_isAEChart_self), and a source avoiding it (chartIso_of_isAEChart_of_subset_regPart). hiso_family has exactly the type of the hiso of existsUnique_causality_singularGX_dec25 (Causal/GXSingularDEC25.lean:553) at A = {kappa // 0 < kappa}, Xalpha = Massive kappa.1, DY = massiveOf, under EAlphaGX.singularGXFamily. existsUnique_causality_ealpha is a true instance with no hidden hypothesis. Its term is existsUnique_causality_singularGX_dec25 applied to minkowski_causallyArcConnected, Flat.isom_strongMorphism, massive_causallyArcConnected, hreg_family, hiso_family and hcov. Only hcov is left, and hcov is the definition of an E_{>0}-manifold. M is in any universe. It is in scope for defi:causal_Ealpha, being ETT.tex:1339-1340 restricted to E_{>0}-manifolds with uniqueness among absolutely minimal causalities (OQ-18). It is equally the E_{>0} half of cor:massA_causalite, whose E0 counterpart existsUnique_causality_e0 is filed there. Keep it in this row as reported and cross-reference it in cor:massA_causalite's notes. The reflection: conjE = shiftIso 0 ConeRot.conjIso. chartIso_conjE holds unconditionally. not_isAEChart_conjE (kappa != 2 pi) goes through exists_eqOn_rotShift, so it rests on the determinant in isom_of_timeAxis. Flat.lorentz is SO0, with det = 1 and future-preserving (Causal/Flat/Form.lean:132). nonvacuous at kappa = pi: rotShift is an IsAEChart whose source contains (0, apex) in singLine pi, so the hypotheses of prop_isom_local and chartIso_of_isAEChart are met at a singular point. Sing(E_pi) is nonempty and covered by refl, so hcov of existsUnique_causality_ealpha is met with a singular point. The checklist vocabulary is off in places (findings); everything is disclosed and the row is partial.

The Lean follows BPrimeE0's slit-box route and builds no cover (the docstring says so at l.91-92). The paper's steps without a Lean counterpart are: the lift to E_inf and the developing-map uniqueness (l.449-451), and the first step (l.446: elliptic holonomy maps to elliptic, which gives beta > 0). In the Lean, beta > 0 is the hypothesis [Fact (0 < kappa')], and the mixed pairs are MassAModelsInstance's causal argument. The conclusions of the alpha > 0 case do each have a counterpart: l.457 smul_timeAxis, l.459 isom_of_timeAxis, l.460 the second preconnectedness step of exists_slitBox, l.462 eq_of_isAEChart. (b') follows from the local form of prop:isom together with four further facts: rotation-translations are causal isomorphisms (chartIso_rotShift); isomorphism is local for absolutely minimal causalities (imp_of_agree_locally in chartIso_of_isAEChart_self); regular sources are hreg's (agreeOn_of_isAEChart, chartIso_of_isAEChart_of_subset_regPart); and kappa = 2 pi is regular (chartIso_of_isAEChart_two_pi). The suggestion that ETT cite prop:isom is sound: defi:causal_Ealpha has no \cite, and l.1325 promises one for each model fact.

findings.what: The finding is true as a proof-level remark on BTZ_1.tex:459, under OQ-82's reading SO0(1,2) x| R^3. A linear part that fixes the future unit vector of Delta acts on the spatial plane orthogonal to it, and it is a rotation only because det = 1; in O^+(1,2) the reflections in timelike planes through Delta also fix Delta. In Lean: under Flat.isom 2 the reflection is not an a.e. isomorphism chart (not_isAEChart_conjE), and it is a ChartIso (chartIso_conjE). The O^+ half ('under O^+ the reflections are a.e. isomorphisms', hence 'OQ-82's answer changes the class of a.e. isomorphisms') is argued by hand and not formalized: there is no O^+ group in the library. The argument is right: in sector charts conjE reads as z -> conj z after rotations, which is orthochronous with det -1. Under O^+ the remark would be statement-level in BTZ_1, not ETT: conjE would be an a.e. isomorphism and an isometry of E_alpha outside Isom(E_alpha) as defined at l.373, against prop:isom's conclusion (l.383) and its first corollary (l.386). That is OQ-82 evidence, not a new question.
findings.fix: Add '(by hand; the O^+ group is not in the library)' to the O^+ half of the finding and of SCOPE's third bullet. In the ledger, classify it as proof-level at BTZ_1.tex:459 and as OQ-82 evidence.

checked_findings.4_planner_r_offset: True; roadmap. Developing g = T_s R_phi determines phi only mod 2 pi, while polar(r, theta + phi) in E_kappa' needs theta + phi mod kappa'. exists_slitBox fixes c = phi + 2 pi m0 by a second preconnectedness argument (hint/hmm, exists_forall_of_isPreconnected). The [r] is true for the right lift of phi, so 'incomplete' is the right word, not 'false'.
checked_findings.5_planner_r_holrel: True; roadmap. Disc charts centred at different directions differ by the rotation through the difference of the centres (EAlphaSector.exists_rotation), which is any real angle. Only charts normalized by a real lift phi' of their centre (rotIsom phi' * chart k', chart_dev) agree up to rotIsom(n kappa'), and HolRel.unique gets n from polar_inj.
checked_findings.6_planner_r_2piZ: True; roadmap. No proof step splits on kappa in 2 pi Z. The only special case is kappa = 2 pi: it is a separate branch in chartIso_of_isAEChart, and mem_singLine_of_isAEChart rules out kappa' = 2 pi when the source meets the line. At kappa' in 2 pi Z, rotIsom kappa' = 1 and HolRel.unique needs nothing more.

question: Agreed: no new OQ (next free id OQ-87, OQ-86 being the highest in registers/DECISIONS.md). The file takes three readings, OQ-82 (Flat.isom 2 = SO0(1,2) x| R^3; DECISIONS.md:239), OQ-64 (isomorphisms of the model spaces = IsAEChart, isomorphisms of topological spacetimes = ChartIso; :221) and OQ-18 (uniqueness among absolutely minimal causalities; :175). Reading prop:isom through IsAEChart is DEC-25's ruled notion (isAEChart_iff_isAEMorphism), not a new reading, and it bears on BTZ_1, not ETT. OQ-34/OQ-35 are cited only as reasons the row stays unmarked. Optionally append to OQ-82 the alpha > 0 evidence (finding 2: conjE is a ChartIso, and is not an a.e. isomorphism chart under SO0). OQ-82's own citation 'ETT.tex l.1331' should read l.1333.

hiso_probe: Checked in /tmp/audit-bpea/Probe.lean (since deleted); axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] throughout. hiso_family plugs directly into MassAModelsInstance.hiso_massAModel_of_sing: `hiso_massAModel_of_sing fun o o' psi hpsi ho ho' _ => match o, o', psi, hpsi, ho, ho' with | some k, some k', psi, hpsi, _, _ => BPrimeEAlpha.hiso_family k k' psi hpsi | none, _, _, _, ho, _ => absurd rfl ho | some _, none, _, _, _, ho' => absurd rfl ho'`. This elaborates against the family hiso `forall o o' psi, IsAEChart psi -> ChartIso (massAModelCausality o) (massAModelCausality o') psi`; IsAEChart is taken under massAModelSingularGX, which is singularGXFamily at some k by rfl. Fed to `massA_singular_models hiso_all hcov`, it gives, for every singular (Flat.isom 2, Minkowski 2)-manifold whose singular points lie in IsAEChart charts into the MassAModel o (DEC-25's E>=0-manifold), a natural causality (IsAtlasCausalityDEC25: every chart a ChartIso, absolutely minimal), unique among absolutely minimal causalities with isomorphic charts covering M, causally arc-connected, with push-up. `forall_exists_massA_models_iff.2 hiso_all` typechecks as well. So the existence half of cor:massA_causalite over every E>=0 model is now dischargeable, with no model hypothesis left. What is still missing: (1) a home for those roughly ten lines, a module importing both graduated files (Causal.Model.BPrimeEAlpha and the graduated MassAModelsInstance). That is T-ett-e-models-bprime, now an assembly, and T-ett-singular-instance then follows in one line plus a witness: massA_dec25_models_e0 exists, and an E_pi witness at family level follows the same way. (2) The readings, none ruled: OQ-18 ('natural'/'unique'), OQ-82 (the group), OQ-34/OQ-35 (E0), and OQ-64 as the reading of 'isomorphism' only. (b') is no longer a missing hypothesis at the E>=0 models. (3) Nothing mathematical.

curation_defi_causal_Ealpha.notes_append: T-ett-bprime-ealpha (atlas-team, 2026-11-21), audit AUDIT-1 minor (line numbers, finding wording, checklist vocabulary, a duplicate helper made private; fixed at graduation), Causal/Model/BPrimeEAlpha.lean. BTZ_1's prop:isom (brunswic2021cauchy, BTZ_1.tex:378-383) for α, β > 0, in local form and in DEC-25's reading. Let ψ : E_κ ⇀ E_κ′ be an a.e. isomorphism chart (IsAEChart for EAlphaGX.singularGX), κ ≠ 2π, whose source meets the singular line. Then κ′ = κ (eq_of_isAEChart), and on a ball about the line point ψ is (t, polar(r, θ)) ↦ (t + s, polar(r, θ + c)) (prop_isom_local; as a rotation-translation, exists_eqOn_rotShift). Conversely every rotation-translation is such a chart (isAEChart_rotShift) and a chart isomorphism (chartIso_rotShift). (b′) at the models E_κ, κ > 0: every IsAEChart E_κ ⇀ E_κ′ is a ChartIso, whether or not its source meets the line (chartIso_of_isAEChart). In the form of the hiso of existsUnique_causality_singularGX_dec25 over {κ // 0 < κ} it is hiso_family. The (G,X) sentence (l.1339-1340) holds on E_{>0}-manifolds: a causality exists, unique among absolutely minimal causalities, with no model hypothesis left (existsUnique_causality_ealpha; non-vacuous at κ = π, nonvacuous). Route: BPrimeE0's slit box at a timelike axis. In SO₀(1,2) ⋉ ℝ³ the stabiliser of the time axis consists of rotations after translations (isom_of_timeAxis): no boost, and the determinant excludes the reflections. gx's branched cover E_∞ is not built. OQ-82: the reflection θ ↦ −θ is a chart isomorphism (chartIso_conjE) and, under Flat.isom 2, not an a.e. isomorphism chart (not_isAEChart_conjE). Hypotheses: α, β ∈ ℝ₊ → special case (α, β > 0; E₀ → E₀ in Causal.Port.BPrimeE0, E₀ ↔ E_κ in MassAModelsInstance); U open connected and φ a local homeomorphism → strengthened (read through IsAEChart: injective, inverse a.e. too), with a local conclusion, which is all (b′) needs; « isomorphisms of the model spaces » → read (OQ-64); Isom(E^{1,2}) → read (OQ-82, used once, through the determinant); « unique » → read (OQ-18); E≥0-manifold → special case (E_{>0}-manifolds). Roadmap, not the paper: the planner's [r] route (A) was incomplete in two places. The rotation offset is fixed modulo κ′ only by a second connectedness step (c = φ + 2πm₀), and the holonomy relation needs target charts normalized by a real lift of their centre. It was confirmed in a third: no case split on κ ∈ 2πℤ is needed, and κ = 2π is the only special case.

Replace the two paper_findings that say the (G,X) sentence 'is not addressed' with the third new finding below. In the last paper_finding, replace « from E_κ, κ ≠ 2π, through the line it is T-ett-bprime-ealpha's » with « and through the line by chartIso_of_isAEChart (T-ett-bprime-ealpha) ».
paper_findings_add: brunswic2021cauchy prop:isom (BTZ_1.tex:378-383), case α, β > 0, is confirmed in local form under DEC-25's reading (an a.e. isomorphism chart through the line): κ′ = κ, and near the line the chart is a rotation about the line after a translation along it (prop_isom_local). Each conclusion of the proof's α > 0 case has a Lean counterpart on a slit-box route: l.457 (gΔ = Δ, smul_timeAxis), l.459 (the stabiliser, isom_of_timeAxis), l.460 (the 2kπ, exists_slitBox) and l.462 (α = β, eq_of_isAEChart). The branched cover E_∞ (l.449-451) is not built.

BTZ_1.tex:459 (« Since the direction of Δ is timelike, g is an elliptic isometry of axis Δ ») holds in SO₀(1,2) ⋉ ℝ³ and uses the determinant: in O↑(1,2) ⋉ ℝ³ the reflections in timelike planes through Δ also preserve Δ. At E_κ the reflection θ ↦ −θ is a chart isomorphism (chartIso_conjE), and under SO₀ it is not an a.e. isomorphism chart (not_isAEChart_conjE). Under O↑ it would be one (by hand), and BTZ_1's Isom(E_α) (l.373) would have to contain it. This is OQ-82 evidence, as at E₀; as far as the reflections go, (b′) is unaffected.

ETT.tex:1339-1340 (« On any E≥0-manifold M there is then a unique causal structure inducing that of E_α in every chart ») holds for E_{>0}-manifolds in DEC-25's reading, with uniqueness among absolutely minimal causalities (existsUnique_causality_ealpha). Its model hypothesis (b′) at E_κ, κ > 0, follows from brunswic2021cauchy prop:isom in local form, since rotation-translations are causal isomorphisms and isomorphism is local for absolutely minimal causalities. ETT.tex:1325 promises « the precise reference for each »: the paper may cite prop:isom at l.1339-1340, at step (B) of prop:GX_sing_espace_temps_topo (l.631-632), or in the proof of cor:massA_causalite (l.1399-1406).

cor_massA_causalite.notes_append: T-ett-bprime-ealpha (2026-11-21): (b′) at the models E_κ, κ > 0, every pair and every source (BPrimeEAlpha.hiso_family). The E_{>0}-manifolds case is existsUnique_causality_ealpha, the counterpart of existsUnique_causality_e0 (listed under defi:causal_Ealpha).
cor_massA_causalite.blocked_on_new: T-ett-e-models-bprime, now an assembly only. The hiso over MassAModel is MassAModelsInstance.hiso_massAModel_of_sing applied to BPrimeEAlpha.hiso_family at (some κ, some κ′), checked in T-ett-bprime-ealpha AUDIT-1's probe with standard axioms. massA_singular_models then gives existence, uniqueness among absolutely minimal causalities, cac and push-up at every E≥0-manifold (DEC-25's reading) with no model hypothesis, and T-ett-singular-instance follows from it. Readings still open: OQ-18 (« natural »), OQ-82 (the group), OQ-34 and OQ-35 (the reading of E₀), and OQ-64, now only as the reading IsAEChart/ChartIso, since (b′) is no longer a missing hypothesis at the E≥0 models.
